description: Canonical image-quality baseline for the photographic lighting plan. Every later step compares against captures reproduced from this manifest; see tools/photographic_baseline.py.
referenceNote: The image this plan aims at. Framed almost exactly like the 'overview' view, so the two compare directly; measured against the baseline in section 6 of the measurements report. Directional target only -- it is 2.22:1 with proportionally less sky than the 16:9 captures, and non-goal 1 rules out pixel matching.
notes: atoll.json is deliberately NOT used: the user considers its environment unauthored. All canonical views live in wind_test.json.

wind_test.json is under active tuning. If its environment block changes, the baseline must be recaptured and the commit above updated -- a level diff is the first thing to check before theorising about a renderer regression.

SINCE 2026-08-15 wind_test.json carries an ENABLED cameraExposure section. The captures in this baseline predate it, so they are the 'no camera' reference: correct for judging the P3 tone curve, but NOT a dormant-equivalence target any more. Gate dormant changes against a copy of the level with the cameraExposure section removed (tools can write one to logs/baseline/).
--shadow-mode is pinned explicitly so the baseline does not silently move if the compiled default flips.
--no-hud is required: the FPS/MS readout is composited into the captured backbuffer and differs between two runs of the same frozen frame.

recipe.resolutionNote: The window is sized from the desktop work area (App::InitWindow: 2560x1440 clamped to workArea.width-8, height = width * 9/16). A different display gives a different capture size; record the actual size with the captures.

modes.description: Native resolution, no upscaler. Render scale 1.0.
The project's normal DLSS quality mode (the compiled default). Render scale ~0.58.

views.title: Atoll overview (front-lit)
views.role: Plan P0 item 1: tropical exterior overview with sky, ocean, sand and foliage. Closest framing to the AI reference image.
views.watchFor: Sand and cloud highlight structure, sky fill on shaded foliage, and the total absence of aerial perspective -- the distant ocean stays crisp all the way to the horizon.

views.title: Shore palm grove (ground level)
views.role: Plan P0 item 2: low camera with shaded foliage, beach contact and bright water. This is the level's own freeCameraStart, captured verbatim from the HUD.
views.watchFor: Readability of foliage in shade, palm/sand contact grounding, and the warm sun-tinted ambient on the sand.

views.title: Sun-facing glint field (back-lit)
views.role: Third view, added with reason (plan P0 allows this if recorded): P2 is explicitly judged on rejecting ocean glints through percentile clipping, and P8 on bloom not turning glints into a white fog bank. Neither of the two views above contains a specular glint field, so without this the acceptance criteria for two milestones would have no canonical frame.
views.watchFor: Whole-frame exposure pumping across the glint field, back-lit shaded foliage collapsing to black, and highlight clipping on the water.
